# Brand report

Verified 2026-09-30. The brand work for zero-server is in the tree and passes
every check below except where a row says otherwise. Nothing is committed by
the verification itself.

## Outcome

The mark is the loop: the zero drawn as a ring with one lit segment between two
narrow slots. In the animated files the segment laps the ring once every three
seconds; under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` it parks at twelve o'clock, and
a renderer without CSS draws the static mark with the segment at one-thirty.
The wordmark `zero-server` is constructed monoline letterforms drawn as paths;
no file references a font.

## Palette

| Token | Name | Hex | HSL hue | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | ink | #16140F | 43 | dark surface; body text on bone |
| `surface` | bone | #F4EEE1 | 41 | light surface; body text on ink |
| `gray-1` | graphite | #57534A | 42 | muted text and rules on bone |
| `gray-2` | ash | #A39E93 | 41 | muted text and rules on ink |
| `hero` | brass | #CFAE45 | 46 | the ring on ink; headings and links on ink |
| `hero-deep` | bronze | #5F470F | 42 | the ring on bone; headings and links on bone |
| `accent` | flare | #D9F542 | 69 | the pulse on ink; focus and status on ink |
| `accent-deep` | moss | #688D00 | 76 | the pulse on bone; large text, focus and status on bone |

Every hue lies between 41 and 76 degrees: nothing in the forbidden 170 to 300
band, and brass at 46 sits well clear of the rust oranges near 18 to 22.

WCAG 2.x contrast, recomputed independently from relative luminance:

| Foreground | On bone | On ink | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ink / bone (body text) | 15.92:1 | 15.92:1 | body text, both surfaces |
| graphite | 6.63:1 | 2.40:1 | muted text on bone only |
| ash | 2.31:1 | 6.90:1 | muted text on ink only |
| brass | 1.85:1 | 8.58:1 | text and ring on ink only |
| bronze | 7.58:1 | 2.10:1 | text and ring on bone only |
| flare | 1.06:1 | 14.98:1 | pulse, focus and status on ink only |
| moss | 3.36:1 | 4.73:1 | large text, focus and status on bone (3:1 minimum), not body text |

Every role in `docs/brand.md` meets its minimum: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for
large text and interface graphics.

## The docs check

`cargo xtask docs --check` exits 1 before it reaches the asset step. The asset
step reads `web/assets/zero-logo.svg` and `web/assets/zero-icon.svg` and expects
`docs/assets/` to hold the same bytes; both sources exist and both copies are
byte-identical, so that step is satisfied once the earlier steps pass.

The failures it reports are the known gaps while release 1 is built, none about
the brand files:

- `crates/zero-server/Cargo.toml`: no `http3`, `codecs` or `websocket` feature,
  `codecs` and `websocket` missing from the default set, and `http1`, `router`
  and `tls` not enabling their dependency crates.
- `crates/zero-server/src/lib.rs`: the feature table has no row for `http1`,
  `router`, `codecs`, `static`, `policy`, `websocket`, `sse`, `tls`, `qpack`, `h3`.
- `zero-bench` and `zero-examples` are claimed by no capability.
- `bindings/node/packages/sdk` is claimed by no capability; the `http`,
  `http3`, `middleware` and `realtime` packages are missing for Node and Python.
- The .NET capability types (`App`, `Request`, `Response`, `Router`, `Json`,
  `StaticFiles`, `Cors`, `SecurityHeaders`, `RequestId`, `TrustProxy`,
  `WebSocketConnection`, `WebSocketPool`, `SseStream`, `TlsOptions`) and the
  `ZeroServer.Http`, `Http3`, `Middleware` and `Realtime` projects do not exist.
- No capability has a guide yet.

## Findings outside the brand files

- The molexxxx profile's card chrome is the profile's shared neutral scheme
  (GitHub-style blue-grays such as #1C222C, #30363D, #7D8590, #D0D7DE). Only the
  zero-server card's accent and icon use the brand. The Node-line pills
  (`zero-server-*-zserver.svg`) keep the Node line's violet theme. Neither is
  part of the new brand, but both carry hues in the 170 to 300 band; restyling
  them is a separate change to the profile generator.
- `crates/xtask/src/site/layout.rs` still sets `THEME_COLOR = "#0f5f56"` and
  inlines the previous colored hexagon mark in `mark()`. Both should become ink
  #16140F and the loop mark.
- `.github/workflows/docs.yml` passes pdoc `--logo
  https://z-server.dev/docs/assets/zero-server-logo.svg`, which matches no file
  name or host in use.
- `docs/brand.md` may need a navigation entry on the site.
- The profile card embeds the icon from the local checkout. Until `assets/` is
  pushed, the profile's scheduled badge run cannot fetch
  `assets/zero-icon-animated.svg`, keeps the committed card and exits 1; once
  it is pushed with the same bytes the run reproduces the same card.
- The Node README's `?v=` stamps for the three zero-server-node pills are stale
  until `stamp-readmes.mjs` runs from the profile repository.

## Not verified

- Rendering through GitHub's image proxy and the live `<picture>` theme switch
  (nothing is pushed).
- Firefox and Safari; a real operating-system reduced-motion setting reaching
  an SVG inside `<img>` (only emulated in Chromium, where the loop keeps running
  inside `<img>`; `docs/brand.md` says to use the static file where motion must
  be off).
- Diagram label widths with macOS system fonts.
